limitations: Base Source Intake is a broad seed, not an exhaustive census.
Seventeen of 36 month/category arXiv queries reached max_results=2000, so paper discovery is known to be truncated in high-volume slices.
Current official index snapshots do not reliably preserve item-level historical events for every publisher.
GitHub Releases coverage is intentionally limited to the configured serving/runtime repository watchlist.
base_feed_gap_fill_coverage: Sora / Video generation models as world simulators (2024-02-15)

audit_method: Period-specific primary-source coverage audit across frontier multimodality and long context, open/open-weight/open-training releases, small/on-device models, MoE and SSM/hybrid architectures, RAG/tool-use/action surfaces, generative image/video/audio, serving/deployment infrastructure, and safety/control/interpretability. Base records are retained; supplemental first-party pages fill material item-level gaps and do not replace base discovery.

coverage_surfaces.notes: OpenAI RSS already preserves item-level GPT-4o and Sora events; Gemini and Claude historical product pages require supplemental item-level preservation and lifecycle normalization.
Material H1 releases include OLMo, Gemma, Llama 3, Qwen2, Grok-1, OpenELM, Arctic and DeepSeek-V2; current publisher indexes alone do not preserve all release pages.
Phi-3, OpenELM and Apple's on-device/server foundation-model work are material to the H1 small-model and edge-deployment shift.
Jamba, Mixtral 8x22B, DBRX, DeepSeek-V2, Arctic and Grok-1 form a material non-dense/efficient-architecture thread.
Command R/R+, Claude-era tool/action work and relevant primary papers establish the transition from chat-only models toward retrieval and execution surfaces.
Base OpenAI feed captures Sora; Stable Diffusion 3, Stable Audio, Google I/O media releases, Kling and Runway Gen-3 require supplemental item-level primary pages.
Base GitHub Release records cover vLLM/SGLang/TensorRT-LLM/llama.cpp/Transformers; NVIDIA NIM and cloud/model-serving launches add deployment product transitions.
Base OpenAI feed preserves the May Model Spec event; long-context jailbreak behavior and mechanistic-interpretability demonstrations require complementary primary sources.
